thread:
asha: Heads-up — onboarding e2e is flapping. Two distinct SDK vs REST parity issues surfaced today: pagination and metrics endpoints.

ben: Can you summarize repros?

asha: Sure. 1) Pagination: REST team uses cursor-based pagination for /v1/admin/teams/:id/members. curl example that works end-to-end:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/teams/123/members?cursor=eyJvZmZzZXQiOjEwMCwicGF0aCI6Ii9tZW1iZXJzIn0='
```

It returns {items: [...], next_cursor: "..."}.

asha: But the Python SDK method `client.admin.list_team_members(team_id=123)` returns a single flattened list by fetching all pages behind the scenes. That would be fine if the SDK respected page_size limits, but it does two problematic things: (a) it sends `pageSize=1000` by default which the server rejects (max 200) causing 400s; (b) when it receives 400 the SDK runtime retries that as a transient error and ends up in a tight retry loop, which killed the onboarding job.

carmen: Ugh. So mismatch in param name/casing and default semantics + retry classification.

ben: What does the outgoing request look like?

asha: Captured outbound from SDK shows `{"pageSize":1000}`. REST expects `page_size` snake_case and enforces max 200. The older SDK used to pass cursor through and return a generator so callers could stream pages; new generator flattened it and added aggressive defaults.

 dave: Minimal repro (Python):

```py
# python sdk
members = client.admin.list_team_members(team_id=123)
len(members) # triggers huge memory use and eventually 400/retry storms
```

asha: 2) Metrics endpoint: onboarding wants team-level usage metrics via /v1/admin/teams/123/metrics but the SDK surface doesn't expose that path at all. We relied on `client.admin.get_team` to include metrics historically, but that field was removed in the swagger and never added back to the generator. So sampleapp can't show onboarding telemetry unless it calls REST directly.

carmen: Two separate fixes then: (A) pagination parity — surface page cursor and avoid aggressive defaults; (B) add missing metrics endpoint to admin namespace in SDK. Also align retry semantics so 4xx are not retried by default.

ben: Agreed. For pagination I'm +1 on making `list_team_members` return an iterator/generator that yields pages and exposing an optional `page_size` parameter (mapped to snake_case). We should not prefetch all pages unless caller asks.

dave: I'll sketch a patch: generator change to keep cursor-based methods, change naming rules to map camelCase -> snake_case for query params, and set default page_size to 100. Also: don't retry on 400/422/409 by default.

asha: Short-term mitigation: sampleapp will call REST endpoints directly for metrics and will implement manual cursor paging for members. I pushed a small hotfix branch that detects SDK returning full list and falls back. Not great but unblocks onboarding CI.

carmen: For tests: add an integration test that asserts SDK passes `page_size` as snake_case and respects server max, and a regression test that ensures 4xx are not retried. Also add a test verifying that admin.get_team does not claim to include metrics unless generator included it.

ben: I'll own the generator templates change. dave take runtime retry classification and tests. carmen can owner integration tests + sampleapp revert once patches land.

deploy-bot: CI: PR #5223 opened by ben — generator templates update. Unit tests queued.

dave: One nuance to discuss: some internal endpoints historically used 409 as a lock and were transient. If we blanket-block retries on 4xx we need a per-endpoint opt-in to treat specific 4xx as transient. I propose a `retry_policy` metadata flag in the OpenAPI for those endpoints so the generator can wire the correct behavior.

asha: Agreed. We'll add that metadata on server side for any transient 4xxs. For now default to REST semantics (don't retry 4xx).

carmen: Filed tracking ticket: https://redwood.internal/p/SDK-PARITY-764 to track pagination parity, missing metrics endpoint, param casing, and retry-policy flag.

ben: Plan: generator patch -> tests -> release patch SDK minor. dave: runtime patch -> tests -> bump runtime. After both merge, revert sampleapp hotfix.

asha: Thanks all. Please drop other SDK vs REST mismatches here if you discover them during onboarding. :thumbsup:
